mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over 3 months signals increased consumer demand and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the HOUST increased by more than 5% within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals increased economic activity and supply, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL growth below 2% annually, signals a stable economic environment, which reduces uncertainty and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods where CPIAUCSL growth was below 2% annually.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong labor demand and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the same period, it signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% MoM and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both RSAFS increased by more than 1% MoM and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth is below 2% annually, it signals a monetary policy mismatch that increases borrowing costs while keeping inflation low, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 4% and CPIAUCSL growth was below 2% annually.
